w1_events.canonical_summary: Quarterly and current share disclosures updated Micron's DRAM, NAND and HBM competitive position alongside CXMT, SK Hynix, YMTC and SanDisk, including Q2 total-market growth and a reported possible CXMT entry into NAND.

facts.proposition: Samsung Electronics and Micron Technology each held 21% of global HBM revenue in Q1 2026.
SK hynix held 58% of global HBM revenue in Q1 2026.
CXMT held approximately 7% of the global DRAM market by revenue in Q2 2026.
A majority of Micron's 2025 DRAM output came from Taiwan.
SK Hynix held approximately 25% of the DRAM market in Q2 2026, down from approximately 29% in Q1 2026.
YMTC increased its NAND revenue or shipment share to about 14% in Q2 2026, from about 9%.
SK Hynix holds a 22% share of the NAND flash market.
Micron held approximately 24% of the DRAM market in Q2 2026, up from about 22%.
Micron held approximately 15% of the NAND market in Q2 2026, up from about 13%, ranking third.
CXMT held about 10% of global DRAM revenue in Q2 2026, up from 4% a year earlier.
The combined market share held by Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron was reduced to 87% from 94%.
DRAM accounts for roughly three-quarters of Micron's revenue.
SanDisk's NAND market share fell to approximately 11% in Q2 2026 from approximately 13% in Q1 2026.
The global DRAM market grew approximately 57% quarter over quarter in Q2 2026.
The global NAND flash market grew approximately 70% quarter over quarter in Q2 2026.
Reuters reported that CXMT was considering entering the NAND/flash-memory market, with Samsung and YMTC as competitors.

w1_events.known_event_summary: 2026-08-28..2026-09-18 Q2 memory-market baseline: Micron held about 24% of DRAM and 15% of NAND, while CXMT, YMTC, SK Hynix and SanDisk shares and total DRAM/NAND growth disclosures updated the competitive structure; Reuters later reported CXMT was considering entering NAND.
w1_events.title: Memory-market share and competitive-position disclosures updated Micron's baseline
